title: Slow English Podcast #374: 20 Easy Facts About Cabo Verde

sentences.text: Today we will learn about a beautiful island country in the Atlantic Ocean.
The country is Cabo Verde.
I will speak slowly and use easy English.
Let's Cabo Verde is an island country in the Atlantic Ocean.
It is located west of Senegal on the coast of West Africa.
The country is made up of several islands.
It has beautiful beaches, mountains, valleys, and volcanic landscapes.
Fact two, the capital city is Praia.
Praia is the capital and largest city of Cabo Verde.
It is located on the island of Santiago.
Praia is an important center for government, business, and culture.
The city has markets, restaurants, historic buildings, and beautiful views of the ocean.
Fact three, Cabo Verde has many islands.
Cabo Verde is made up of 10 main islands.
Nine of these islands are inhabited.
Each island has its own landscapes and traditions.
Some islands have high mountains.
Others are famous for beaches and desert -like landscapes.
Fact four, Portuguese is the official language.
Portuguese is the official language of Cabo Verde.
Many people also speak Cape Verde and Creole.
The Creole language is called Creoleu by many local people.
English and French can also be heard in tourist areas.
Language is an important part of Cape Verdean culture.
Fact five, Cabo Verde has volcanic islands.
The islands were formed by volcanic activity.
Some islands have large mountains and old volcanic landscapes.
Fogo Island has an active volcano called Pico do Fogo.
It is one of the most famous natural features of the country.
The volcanic landscape is very interesting.
Fact six, Cabo Verde has beautiful beaches.
Many islands have wonderful beaches.
The water is clear and blue.
People enjoy swimming, relaxing and walking along the coast.
Sal and Boa Vista are especially famous for their beaches.
Tourism is very important to these islands.
Fact seven, Cabo Verde has a warm climate.
The country has a generally warm and dry climate.
Temperatures are usually pleasant during much of the year.
There can be less rain than in many other parts of West Africa.
The islands can also have strong winds.
The warm weather attracts many visitors.
Fact eight, fishing is important.
Cabo Verde is surrounded by the Atlantic Ocean.
Fishing is an important activity for many coastal communities.
People catch different kinds of fish.
Fish is also an important part of local food.
The ocean plays a major role in island life.
Fact nine, Cabo Verde has delicious food.
Cape Verde and food uses fish, beans, corn, vegetables and meat.
One of the most famous dishes is Kachupa.
Kachupa is a traditional dish made with corn, beans, vegetables, and sometimes meat or fish.
It is an important part of Cape Verde and food culture.
Many families enjoy it together.
Fact ten, music is very important.
Music is one of the most famous parts of Cape Verde and culture.
Mourna is a traditional style of music.
It is often slow and emotional.
Another popular style is Coladera.
Cape Verde and music is enjoyed both inside and outside the country.
Fact eleven, Caesarea Vora was from Cabo Verde.
Caesarea Vora was one of the most famous singers from Cabo Verde.
She was known around the world for her beautiful voice.
She helped make Cape Verde and music famous internationally.
She was often called the Barefoot Diva.
Her music is an important part of the country's cultural identity.
Fact twelve, Cabo Verde has beautiful mountains.
Some islands have high mountains and deep valleys.
Santo Anto is famous for its green mountains and hiking trails.
The island has dramatic landscapes.
Visitors can walk through valleys and small villages.
Mountain tourism is popular in Cabo Verde.
Fact thirteen, Cabo Verde has interesting wildlife.
The islands are home to many types of birds and sea animals.
Some beaches are important nesting places for sea turtles.
Loggerhead turtles are especially important in Cabo Verde.
Protecting these animals is an important environmental goal.
Visitors can sometimes see turtles near the coast.
Fact fourteen, Football is very popular.
Football is one of the most popular sports in Cabo Verde.
Children often play football with friends.
People watch important matches together.
The national football team is known as the Blue Sharks.
Football is an important part of community life.
Fact fifteen, Cabo Verde has colorful festivals.
People celebrate many festivals throughout the year.
Music, dancing, food, and colorful clothing are common.
Carnival is especially famous in some cities.
The streets can become full of music and celebrations.
Festivals are a great way to experience local culture.
Fact sixteen, Cabo Verde has a strong island culture.
Life on the islands is closely connected to the sea.
Fishing, music, family, and community are important.
Each island has its own character and traditions.
People are proud of their island heritage.
The ocean connects the islands together.
Fact seventeen, Tourism is very important.
Many visitors come to Cabo Verde every year.
They enjoy beaches, hiking, music, food, and warm weather.
Sal and Boa Vista are popular tourist destinations.
Other islands are better known for nature and mountains.
Cabo Verde offers many different travel experiences.
Fact eighteen, Cabo Verde has beautiful sunsets.
The country is surrounded by the Atlantic Ocean.
This gives visitors many opportunities to enjoy sunsets by the sea.
The sky can become orange, pink, and red.
Walking along the beach at sunset is a popular activity.
It is one of the simple pleasures of island life.
Fact nineteen, People in Cabo Verde are known for hospitality.
Visitors are often welcomed warmly.
People enjoy sharing food, music, and stories.
Family and friendship are important.
Travelers can learn about the country by spending time with local people.
Hospitality is an important part of Cape Verdean culture.
Fact twenty, Cabo Verde is a country full of beauty and music.
It has volcanic mountains, beautiful beaches, blue oceans, traditional food, wonderful music, and colorful festivals.
Visitors can enjoy nature, culture, history, and island life.
Cabo Verde may be a small country, but it has many wonderful things to discover.
Thank you for listening to the Slow English podcast.
I hope you learned something new today.
Keep listening, keep practicing, and keep enjoying English.
My name is Emily.
See you in the next episode.
